title: Compare European descriptor Ability scene
changes: Add an opt-in differential-scene assertion for typed descriptor pointer, field0 and field2 reads.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine comparison passed 540 complete state/clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio frames; the same run served 64 typed pointer and field bytes with guarded inputs and sources unchanged.
limitations: Field4, kind and byte7 were not exercised; both arms share the native cache. Other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
